node.title: ImgFib Conjecture-F route retirement and exact residual partition
node.statement: The historical conj_f requirement in imgfib has no branch-to-flat transport and is not needed by the repaired LIST assembly. Full-petal contributors split into the proved top-band/E=0 payments and the exact direct TARGET l1_full_petal_fpc5_payment; mixed or diffuse partial-petal contributors are the disjoint direct TARGET l1_mixed_petal_amplification. The ordinary-Johnson, exact-periodic, profile, and taxonomy interfaces remain separately wired. Hence no current imgfib branch is passed to Conjecture F, and removing the conj_f requirement loses no claimed LIST payment. This proves route retirement only, not either direct L1 target or Conjecture F.
node.falsifier: a current imgfib branch whose only stated payment is Conjecture F, a full-petal branch outside the proved payments and FPC5, or overlap between the FPC5 and mixed/partial targets
